declaration-no-important.message: Do not use !important. It indicates broken selector specificity. Refactor selectors or use CSS Modules scoping instead.

media-feature-name-disallowed-list.message: Do not write raw @media queries with min-width/max-width. Use '@include wider-than("breakpoint")' or '@include narrower-than("breakpoint")' from '@universe/ui/breakpoints.scss'.

selector-class-pattern.message: Expected class selector to be camelCase, kebab-case, or BEM

keyframes-name-pattern.message: Expected keyframe name to be camelCase or kebab-case
